profile.name: KEL10X 直流电子负载
profile.description: KEL10X 是一类可编程直流电子负载，用于吸收电源、充电器、电池或电源模块输出的电能，并对被测设备进行带载测试。根据现有证据，该设备支持恒流与恒压工作模式、远端感测、面板锁定以及电压、电流、功率测量，适合实验室中的电源性能验证与基础负载测试。
profile.description_en: The KEL10X is a programmable DC electronic load used to sink power from supplies, chargers, batteries, or power modules during load testing. Based on the available evidence, it supports constant-current and constant-voltage modes, remote sense, front-panel lock, and measurement of voltage, current, and power, making it suitable for laboratory power characterization and basic load testing.

registry.name: Korad KEL10x DC Electronic Load
registry.description: Korad KEL10x DC Electronic Load是由Korad Technology生产的电池测试柜，主要功能包括初始化、测量、电流设置。支持Signal, Slot, lock front panel等操作。
